sources (e.g., Copernicus Dias, National missions, etc.) allowing data interoperabilityUsers' management, addressing user authentication, authorization and interactionsBilling management: managing all and providing access to applications: allowing usage of applications available on the systems and allowing download of applicationsHosting and providing access to services: allowing users to access and exploit the offered servicesHosting and providing access to Digital Twin of Italy: allowing users to access and exploit the Digital Twin capabilitiesThe Application/Toolbox and Marketplace
